newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian rates steady, trade brisk.
newsitem.headline: Croatian rates steady, trade brisk.

text.p: ZAGREB, Jan 22 ( Reuter) - Croatian interbank rates were steady in Wednesday's brisk morning trade amid growing demand and abundant supply of kuna funds.
Trade totalled 57.3 million kuna by mid-morning against 90 million on offer.

Fresh borrowings accounted for 43.5 million kuna most of which was call money granted at a steady 11 percent rate. Term loans were struck at rates in a 13-16 percent range. Banks rolled over previous loans at rates ranging between 11 and 14 percent.
Overnight trade on Tuesday totalled 15 million kuna sought by a bank for its mandatory reserve. -- Laura Lui, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
